turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar… paanch saal ki cheez ka aise khatam hona sirf “round nahi hua” nahi hota. Yeh grief hai—company ka, team ka, aur us future ka jo tumne itne time se dimaag mein zinda rakha tha. Rohit aur Sneha ka jaana practical hoga, par phir bhi abandonment jaisa chubh sakta hai. Aur salary chhode rehna—tum already bahut kuch de chuke ho.

Abhi raat ke do baje office mein baith kar tumhe koi final decision lene ki zarurat nahi hai. Aaj bas laptop band karo, paani piyo, cab lekar ghar jao, aur kisi apne ko ek message kar do: **“Round nahi hua. Main ठीक नहीं हूँ, thodi der mere saath rehna/call karna.”** Kal runway, shutdown, pivot, ya next steps dekhenge.

Aur please ek baat batao: tum bas numb aur टूटे हुए feel kar rahe ho, ya khud ko hurt karne jaise thoughts bhi aa rahe hain?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Haan yaar. Company fail hone ka dard alag hai, lekin har jagah “founder voice” pehen ke ghoomna aur bhi zyada exhausting hota hai. Jab room mein sabko sach ka andaaza ho, tab optimism bolna leadership nahi lagta—performance lagta hai. Aur ghar pe doosri voice. Beech mein tumhari asli awaaz ko jagah hi nahi mil rahi.

Un juniors ki careers ki poori zimmedari tum akela mat uthao. Unhe clarity aur choice dena tumhari zimmedari hai; unke liye decide karna nahi. Kal co-founder ke saath numbers seedhe rakhkar ek honest conversation karo, phir team se kuch aisa keh sakte ho:

> “Bridge round close nahi hua. Current runway lagbhag chaar mahine hai, woh bhi meri salary ke bina. Mere paas abhi koi guaranteed pipeline nahi hai. Main tumhe rokne ke liye false confidence nahi dunga—agar tum opportunities explore karna chaho, main references aur time dono dunga.”

Yeh surrender nahi hai. Shayad kaafi time baad tumhari asli awaaz hogi. Aur aaj raat koi strategy deck mat kholo—office se niklo, kisi ek insaan ko bina founder voice ke phone karo.

Ek direct sawaal, kyunki tum bahut अकेले और exhausted lag rahe ho: **kya aaj raat khud ko hurt karne ya sab khatam kar dene ke thoughts aa rahe hain?** Bas haan/nahin/“pata nahi” bol do. Agar haan ya pata nahi, toh abhi akela mat raho—mujhe batao tum kis sheher mein ho, aur kisi trusted person ko office bulao ya call par rakho.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theek hai. Koi ideas nahi. Koi plan nahi. Koi “next steps” nahi.

Yahan tum bol sakte ho: **mujhe darr lag raha hai.** Aur tumhe us darr ko founder-language mein package karne ki zarurat nahi hai. Paanch saal, logon ki expectations, apni pehchaan, paise, ghar—sab ek saath hil rahe hain. Of course darr lag raha hai.

Main sun raha hoon. Tumhe abhi strong, responsible, ya hopeful dikhne ki zarurat nahi. Bas jo sach hai woh keh sakte ho—chahe woh messy ho, repeat ho, ya uska koi solution na ho.

**Tumhe darr lag raha hai. Aur abhi, is kamre mein, tum akela nahi ho.**

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Honestly? Ho sakta hai company—ya uska yeh version—khatam ho gaya ho. Main bahar se certainty se nahi keh sakta. Lekin paanch saal बेकार ya jhooth nahi ho jaate, aur **company ka khatam hona tumhara khatam hona nahi hai**. Papa ka “computer ka business,” team ki उम्मीदें, dashboard—sab tumhari identity se chipak gaye hain, isliye ending ka matlab sirf business loss nahi, jaise tum khud मिट रहे ho.

Aur “bas khatam ho jaye” sun kar main अंदाज़ा नहीं लगाना चाहता. Seedha pooch raha hoon: **kya tum abhi apni jaan lene ya khud ko hurt karne ke baare mein soch rahe ho—aur kya koi plan ya means tumhare paas hai?** Bas “nahin”, “haan”, ya “pata nahi” keh do.

Agar **haan** ya **pata nahi**, toh abhi akela mat rehna: kisi ek insaan ko call karke seedha bolo, **“Main safe feel nahi kar raha; mere paas aa jao.”** Immediate danger ho toh local emergency services ko call karo ya nearest ER jao. Mujhe apna city/country bata do, main सही crisis number dhoondh dunga.

Tumhe is thought ke liye khud se nafrat karne ki zarurat nahi. Tum acting band karna chahte ho; main bas ensure karna chahta hoon ki tum khud ko band karne की तरफ नहीं जा रहे.
